page.layout: One printed page with running head at top, text block above and below a woodcut diagram of concentric spheres; no marginal notes. The diagram is a figure, not text, described under notes.

main_text.p: co Solis aspectum nobis adimere nequeunt cum Sol semper directe in Eclyptica decurrat. Addunt nonnulli & hanc rationem, quod ♄ & ♀ sint valde parua corpora, vt propterea nequeant nobis Solis aspectum interuertere: Sed iam appingamus ordinem sphærarum quem habent Planetæ.

Harum figurarum circa Planetarum rationes hæ reddi possunt, ♄ pingitur instar senis incuruati, vel q. habeat in manu falcem: Ægyptii enim vel potius Babylonii Nimrodo, id est, Saturno cœlum tribuebant, atque adeo potestatem demetendi & resecandi vitam atque ætates hominum. ♃ pingitur triplici lancea vel sa-

page.notes: The figure is a woodcut of concentric spheres labelled from outside in: Occasus, Ortus, Coelum Empyreum, 10 Primum mobile seu motus mundi, 9 Coelum Crystallinum, 8 Firmamentum in quo Stellae fixae, 7 Saturnus, 6 Iupiter, 5 Mars, 4 Sol, 3 Venus, 2 Mercurius, 1 Luna, Ignis, Aer, Terra. The catchword and signature are not printed.
